task_header.task: I have received job application emails for Sales Manager role over the last 2 weeks. I need you to do two things for my ongoing recruiting process. 1. Create a "job_applications.csv" file with the headers "First Name", "Last Name" and "LinkedIn URL" fields, the values of which should be extracted from the emails. Skip ones who did not provide their LinkedIn URLs in their emails. 2. Download their email attachments in "attachments/<first_name>__<last_name>/" directory. Replace <first_name> and <last_name> as per their names (lower cased), and use file names as per their attachment names in the email. The csv file and "attachments/" directory should be in "~/documents/work/recruiting/" directory in my file system.
